positions.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
positions.frame: How does a directive to forget or remove knowledge perform authority over what the record retains?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives issued by the account holder commanding the recipient to alter their knowledge state — one to forget a named decision, the other to remove all knowledge of a named migration. They share the same directional read: authority-ranking performed through deletion commands, flat matter-of-fact register, calm-negative affect, and decision-grade conviction. The frame asks what these erasure directives do as power moves over the informational record.
